The '''Catfish''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the river (in [[Pelican Town]] or [[Cindersap Forest]]), and the [[Farm Maps|Riverlands Farm]], [[Farm Maps|Forest Farm]], or [[Farm Maps|Hill-Top Farm]] during [[Spring]] and [[Fall]] when raining, or in the [[Secret Woods]] or [[Witch's Swamp]] during [[Spring]], [[Summer]], and [[Fall]] when raining. It can also be caught in [[Winter]] at these locations if a [[Rain Totem]] is used. 

It can also be acquired from the following:
*A [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]] may gift it to the player.
*[[Garbage Can]]s may randomly contain one during Spring and Fall.
*The [[Traveling Cart]] may randomly sell one for {{Tprice|200}}.
*[[Linus]] may randomly send a Catfish in the mail as a gift.
*One Catfish is contained in the [[Bundles#Fish Tank|Community Center Fish Tank]] right after the Community Center is repaired.

Catfish can be caught regardless of weather, time, or season using [[Magic Bait]].

==Map==
The Catfish can be found in the river, in the Secret Woods pond when it's raining, and in the Witch's Swamp.

==Tailoring==
Catfish can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Fish Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt158.png|24px]]

==Fish Pond==
Catfish can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 4 days.  The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests.  The only possible output is dark gray Catfish [[Roe]].

==Quests==
*'''Item Delivery:''' One Catfish may be randomly requested in [[Spring]] or [[Fall]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|600}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*'''Fishing:''' [[Demetrius]] or [[Willy]] may randomly request 1-4 Catfish to be caught in [[Spring]] or [[Fall]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|200}} per fish.  (You get to keep the fish). 

==Bugs==
*Catfish may be requested in a '''Fishing''' quest during Winter, requiring a [[Rain Totem]] to be used, despite 1.4.4 version patch notes detailing its removal from the quest.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Removed from garbage cans and most quests in Winter.  Added iridium quality.  Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}}
{{History|1.4.4|Fixed a mistake in the game data that prevented catfish-specific fish pond data from being applied (in earlier versions, catfish used the same fish pond data as all generic river fish). Catfish can no longer be requested by [[Demetrius]] or [[Willy]] in a [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|Fishing Help Wanted quest]] during [[Winter]].}}
{{History|1.6|One is contained in the [[Bundles#Fish Tank|Community Center Fish Tank]] right after it is repaired. Can now be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].}}
